# Chapter 12 — 你穿得太少了 (You Wear Too Little)

**Pinyin:** Nǐ chuān de tài shǎo le  
**Source:** *HSK Standard Course 2*, printed pages 89–96 (source image pages 109–116).

## New Words

| No. | Chinese | Pinyin | English | Source |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 得 | de | structural particle used after a verb or adjective to introduce a complement of result or degree | p. 90 |
| 2 | 妻子 | qīzi | n. wife | p. 90 |
| 3 | 雪 | xuě | n. snow | p. 91 |
| 4 | 零 | líng | num. zero | p. 91 |
| 5 | 度 | dù | n. degree | p. 91 |
| 6 | 穿 | chuān | v. to wear; to put on | p. 91 |
| 7 | 进 | jìn | v. to enter; to come/go in | p. 91 |
| 8 | 弟弟 | dìdi | n. younger brother | p. 91 |
| 9 | 近 | jìn | adj. near; close | p. 91 |

The numbered New Words entries contain no subentries.

## Proper Names

None in this chapter's New Words entries or lesson text.

## Unique Hanzi in New Words

Distinct characters in the numbered entries, listed once in order of first appearance: **得、妻、子、雪、零、度、穿、进、弟、近** (10 characters).

## Warm-up Vocabulary

The p. 89 picture-matching warm-up includes **妻子、睡觉、房间、下雪、起床、房子**. The verb-object exercise prompts **说、开、准备、读、找、学习** (with 学汉语 as its example). These are warm-up items, not additional numbered New Words.

## Characters

The Characters section on printed p. 95 teaches two radicals, with their explanations and example characters:

- **止** (止字旁): generally related to toes; examples **趾** (zhǐ, toe) and **步** (bù, step).
- **门** (门字头): generally related to relations among things or their appearance; examples **同** (tóng, same) and **网** (wǎng, net).

The radicals and example characters are separate from the New Words list.
